sections.title: World Generation
sections.content: This ore generates naturally between **Y: -64 to Y: 16**, in veins of 2 to 6 blocks per chunk.

sections.content: Can be refined in a furnace to obtain refined metal ingots or used to construct special enchantment workstations.
